exposure: GDM treated with medical nutritional therapy (MNT) (GDM-M)
cohort: 752 women with GDM-I and 567 women with GDM-M
finding: Women with GDM-I had a greater risk of polyhydramnios and caesarean section, and their offspring had higher rates of macrosomia, LGA, and NICU admissions compared to women with GDM-M.
mod_finding: Women with gestational diabetes treated with insulin had a greater risk of polyhydramnios and were more likely to deliver by cesarean section compared to women treated with medical nutritional therapy.
